corePassives.description:
Many of Szayelaporro's attacks summon his Fracciones to attack. After attacking, these Fracciones turn into Sacrificial Materials on the field. Szayelaporro can detonate them using a Special Attack to grant teammates stacks of Intel Control. Each stack increases Spirit Mastery by 0.4% for 20 seconds, up to 6 stacks. 
 When entering Resurreccion, Szayelaporro grants all Spirit characters 1 stack of Sample Analysis. Whenever an on-field character with Sample Analysis deals damage, all Spirit characters gain 1 additional stack of Sample Analysis. Each stack increases their Crit DMG by 0.5% for 30 seconds, stacking up to 30 times. 
 When the team includes 1/2 Spirit characters other than Szayelaporro, the buff effects provided by Intel Control, Sample Analysis, and the passives Research Expert, Backstage Monitoring, and Corridor Modification are increased to 2/4 times their original values.
corePassives.name: Miserable End

corePassives.description: Each time Szayelaporro releases a technique or counterattack, the entire team's ATK increases by 10% for 20 seconds.
corePassives.name: Research Expert

corePassives.description: At the start of battle, if Szayelaporro's ATK is higher than 3280, every additional 500 ATK increases the effect of Intel Control by 0.15%, up to 0.6%.
corePassives.name: Backstage Monitoring

corePassives.description: At the start of battle, if Szayelaporro's Crit DMG is higher than 75, every additional 25 Crit DMG increases the effect of Sample Analysis by 0.25%, up to 1%.
corePassives.name: Corridor Modification

skills.description:
Szayelaporro swings his Zanpakuto, dealing 5 hits for a total damage of 285% of ATK. The 3rd to 5th hits each summon a Fraccion to assist, leaving behind 1 Sacrificial Material at the original location.  ~~Master  Szayelaporro!~~ Tap and hold Basic Attack while Sacrificial Material exists on the field 
 Denotates all Sacrificial Materials on the field, with each one dealing equal to 80% of ATK. During Resurreccion, whenever Intel Control is gained, the same number of Brutal Modification stacks is also gained, up to 6 stacks. ~~Don't Make Me Do It Myself~~ Resurreccion 
 Szayelaporro commands his Fracciones to continuously attack enemies, dealing 3 hits for a total of 415% of ATK as damage. Each hit leaves behind 1 Sacrificial Material at the original location.
skills.name: Modification Research

skills.description: Szayelaporro activates a trap beneath the enemy, pulling nearby enemies slightly and dealing damage equal to 265% of ATK. After release, it can directly chain into the 3rd hit of basic attack.
skills.name: Trap Activation

skills.description:
Szayelaporro releases the power within his Zanpakuto to enter Resurreccion. In this state, his basic attacks and Special Attacks are enhanced, but he cannot move, dodge, or counter. During Resurreccion, even while off-field, Szayelaporro commands his Fracciones to perform combo attacks whenever the on-field teammate deals Spirit DMG. Each round of combo attacks has 3 hits, dealing a total damage equal to 420% of his ATK, and each hit leaves behind 1 Sacrificial Material at the original location. ~~Control of the Five Senses~~ During Resurreccion, release it again at Max Ultimate Energy 
 Szayelaporro creates a doll of the enemy and crushes its internal organs, dealing Base DMG equal to 1047.5% of ATK and consuming all Brutal Modification stacks. Each stack of Brutal Modification increases this skill's damage by 10%. If 6 stacks are consumed at once, this skill is guaranteed to trigger a critical hit. During Resurreccion, if Szayelaporro is the only remaining character in the team, he immediately gains full Ultimate Energy.
skills.name: Slip, Fornicaras

skills.description:
After Szayelaporro neutralizes an enemy attack, he summons two Fracciones to rapidly strike the enemy, dealing damage equal to 625% of ATK and leaving behind 3 Sacrificial Materials, then automatically releases a Special Attack. 
 During Resurreccion, Szayelaporro cannot actively counter, and the counterattack released when switching onto the field will be replaced with a Special Attack.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Use Sonido to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Szayelaporro gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
skills.name: Sonido
